entries.titleEn: 7th National Cybersecurity Month to Be Celebrated Under the Theme “An Aware Citizen for a Secure Nation”
Congratulatory Message on the Formation of the New Government
Financial Sector Cybersecurity Forum Officially Established

The Director General of the Information Network Security Administration (INSA), H.E. Mrs. Tigist Hamid, has extended her warm New Year wishes to all citizens of Ethiopia, as well as to the institution's leadership and staff members.
